_about: PARKED. What each face button holds in each stance (Game Design's matrix, docs/design/melee-press-feel.md sections 10 and 13): X quick, Y strong, A the stance's context action, B its signature. Only the martial arts stance is filled; the other four come with their slices. A filter is part values that must all hold; any is a list of filters of which one must.
_spread: each pick marks down the shapes that share its path, its target or its tip, and more those that share limb, path and target, so a cell spreads over the grammar

x.what: light strikes: the light, the flurry blow, the skill strike, the juggle strike
x._quotas: filled in this order before the cell is filled freely. The first five are the stick's leans (a weight of 3 at run time, not a filter). The last two keep both readings deep: a juggle is up to 5 skill strikes (Orb)

y.what: heavy strikes: the guard breaker, the lift, the ender; a fully held lone heavy may launch (Orb)

a.what: today's context actions, one for each context; not generated

b.what: the stance's signature. Its kind is not final (Orb wants charts and alternatives), so the frame is generic and nothing is hand-picked

slots.from: a lunge from the mid band; nothing in reach
